title: Generating interesting scientific ideas using knowledge graphs and LLMs: Evaluations with 100 research group leaders
summary_zh: 本文研究利用知识图谱和LLM生成科学想法。方法上，构建了包含5800万篇论文的知识图谱，并使用LLM生成个性化想法。实验表明，专家对生成的想法兴趣评分适中。
summary_en: This paper studies generating scientific ideas using knowledge graphs and LLMs. The method constructs a knowledge graph of 58 million papers and uses an LLM to generate personalized ideas. Experiments show that experts rate the generated ideas moderately interesting.
insights: 创新点：利用知识图谱和LLM生成个性化科学想法
方法亮点：构建了大规模知识图谱，并使用LLM进行个性化生成
关键发现：专家对生成的想法兴趣评分适中
insights_en: Novelty: Generating personalized scientific ideas using knowledge graphs and LLMs
Method highlight: Constructing a large-scale knowledge graph and using LLM for personalized generation
Key finding: Experts rate the generated ideas moderately interesting
abstract: The rapid growth of scientific literature makes it increasingly challenging for researchers to identify novel and impactful ideas, especially across disciplines. Modern AI systems offer new opportunities for scientific ideation, but how compelling are AI-generated ideas, and how can their quality be improved? Here, we introduce SCIMUSE , which generates personalized research ideas using a knowledge graph of 58 million papers and a large language model (LLM). A central focus of this work is to understand how interesting these ideas are. Therefore, we conducted a large-scale evaluation in which more than 100 research group leaders—spanning the natural sciences to the humanities—rated over 4,400 personalized ideas according to their level of interest. Overall, expert ratings were modest (mean 2.40 on a 5-point scale, most common rating 1), while 24.9% of ideas were rated 4 or 5. We find that supplying concept pairs selected using the knowledge graph does not improve expert-rated interest over a titles-only GPT baseline. High-citation-predicted pairs even showed a weak tendency (1.94 σ ) toward lower interest than random pairs. Nevertheless, graph features can be used to control properties of ideas, and, using this unique evaluation dataset, we show that idea interest can be predicted with both a supervised neural network based on graph features and a zero-shot ranking approach based on an LLM. Our work provides an AI methodology for generating scientific ideas and a large-scale interdisciplinary expert evaluation, paving the way to study and improve difficult-to-measure metrics such as expert-perceived scientific interestingness.

title: Mitigating Covariate Shift in Behavioral Cloning via Robust Stationary Distribution Correction
summary_zh: 本文研究行为克隆中的协变量偏移问题。提出基于稳健的平稳分布校正方法。实验表明，该方法有效减轻了偏移。
summary_en: This paper investigates the covariate shift issue in behavioral cloning. A robust stationary distribution correction method is proposed. Experiments show that this method effectively mitigates the shift.
insights: 创新点：提出稳健的平稳分布校正方法
方法亮点：有效减轻协变量偏移
关键发现：方法在行为克隆中有效
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed a robust stationary distribution correction method
Method highlight: Effectively mitigates covariate shift
Key finding: Method is effective in behavioral cloning
abstract: We consider offline imitation learning (IL), which aims to train an agent to imitate from the dataset of expert demonstrations without online interaction with the environment. Behavioral Cloning (BC) has been a simple yet effective approach to offline IL, but it is also well-known to be vulnerable to the covariate shift resulting from the mismatch between the state distributions induced by the learned policy and the expert policy. Moreover, as often occurs in practice, when expert datasets are collected from an arbitrary state distribution instead of a stationary one, these shifts become more pronounced, potentially leading to substantial failures in existing IL methods. Specifically, we focus on covariate shift resulting from arbitrary state data distributions, such as biased data collection or incomplete trajectories, rather than shifts induced by changes in dynamics or noisy expert actions. In this paper, to mitigate the effect of the covariate shifts in BC, we propose DrilDICE, which utilizes a distributionally robust BC objective by employing a stationary distribution correction ratio estimation (DICE) to derive a feasible solution. We evaluate the effectiveness of our method through an extensive set of experiments covering diverse covariate shift scenarios. The results demonstrate the efficacy of the proposed approach in improving the robustness against the shifts, outperforming existing offline IL methods in such scenarios.

title: Intrinsically motivated humans and agents in open-world exploration
summary_zh: 研究比较人类、儿童和AI在开放世界探索中的内在动机。方法上，使用Crafter环境研究熵、信息增益和赋权。实验表明，三者与探索进度正相关，熵和赋权在儿童中更相关。
summary_en: This study compares intrinsic motivation in humans, children, and AI agents in open-world exploration. The method involves using the Crafter environment to study entropy, information gain, and empowerment. Experiments show that all three are positively correlated with exploration progress, with entropy and empowerment more strongly related to children's progress.
insights: 创新点：比较人类、儿童和AI的内在动机
方法亮点：使用Crafter环境研究探索动机
关键发现：熵和赋权与儿童探索进度更相关
insights_en: Novelty: Comparing intrinsic motivation in humans, children, and AI agents
Method highlight: Studying exploration motivation using the Crafter environment
Key finding: Entropy and empowerment are more strongly related to children's exploration progress
abstract: What drives exploration? Understanding the intrinsic motivation to explore is a long-standing challenge in both cognitive science and AI. In this study, we directly compare adults, children aged 8 to 12 y, and AI agents exploring a complex, open-ended environment called Crafter ( 1 ). We study how three common information-theoretic intrinsic objectives—entropy, information gain, and empowerment—relate to their behavior. We find that all three are positively correlated with human exploration progress for both children and adults, although entropy and empowerment are more strongly related to exploration progress in children than information gain. Furthermore, across agents and humans we observe that entropy initially increases rapidly, then plateaus, while empowerment increases continuously, suggesting that in early exploration they look for novel states, while in advanced exploration they look for states they can control. Finally, we find preliminary evidence that private speech about goals may aid exploration in children. Our data are available at https://github.com/alyd/humans_in_crafter_data .

AnyNav: Visual neuro-symbolic friction learning for off-road navigation
summary_zh: 研究越野导航问题。提出基于神经符号的视觉摩擦估计和导航框架。结合视觉感知和物理模型。
summary_en: Studies off-road navigation. Introduces a vision-based friction estimation and navigation framework grounded in neuro-symbolic principles. Integrates visual perception with a physical model.
insights: 创新点：结合视觉感知和物理模型
方法亮点：神经符号方法应用于导航
关键发现：提高导航在复杂环境中的泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Integrates visual perception with a physical model
Method highlight: Applies neuro-symbolic methods to navigation
Key finding: Improves navigation generalization in complex environments
abstract: Off-road navigation is critical for a wide range of field robotics applications from planetary exploration to disaster response. However, it remains a longstanding challenge due to unstructured environments and the inherently complex terrain–vehicle interactions. Traditional physics-based methods struggle to accurately capture the nonlinear dynamics underlying these interactions, while purely data-driven approaches often overfit to specific motion patterns, vehicle geometries, or platforms, limiting their generalization in diverse, real-world scenarios. To address these limitations, we introduce AnyNav, a vision-based friction estimation and navigation framework grounded in neuro-symbolic principles. Our approach integrates neural networks for visual perception with symbolic physical models for reasoning about terrain-vehicle dynamics. To enable learning in a self-supervised manner for real-world settings, we adopt the imperative learning paradigm, where a bilevel optimization framework leverages physics-based optimization for training the friction network. This explicit incorporation of physical reasoning substantially improves generalization across terrains, vehicle types, and operating conditions. Leveraging the predicted friction coefficients, we further develop a physics-informed navigation system capable of generating physically feasible, time-efficient paths together with corresponding speed profiles. We demonstrate that AnyNav seamlessly transfers from simulation to real-world robotic platforms, exhibiting strong robustness across different four-wheeled vehicles and diverse off-road environments.

Conveyor-mode electron shuttling through a T-junction in Si/SiGe
summary_zh: 本文介绍了一种通过T-junction在Si/SiGe中进行电子穿梭的方法。实验测量了电子穿梭的保真度。结果表明，穿梭保真度高达100%。
summary_en: This paper introduces a method for electron shuttling through a T-junction in Si/SiGe. The fidelity of electron shuttling is measured experimentally. The results show that the fidelity is as high as 100%.
insights: 创新点：T-junction实现电子穿梭
方法亮点：无需额外控制线
关键发现：穿梭保真度极高
insights_en: Novelty: T-junction enables electron shuttling
Method highlight: No extra control lines required
Key finding: Extremely high fidelity of shuttling
abstract: Abstract Conveyor-mode shuttling in gated Si/SiGe devices enables adiabatic transfer of single electrons, electron patterns and spin qubits confined in quantum dots across several microns with a scalable number of signal lines. To realize their full potential, linear shuttle lanes must connect into a two-dimensional grid with controllable routing. We introduce a T-junction device linking two independently driven shuttle lanes. Electron routing across the junction requires no extra control lines beyond the four channels per conveyor belt. We measure an inter-lane charge transfer fidelity of $$F={100.0000000}_{-9\times 1{0}^{-7}}^{+0}\,\%$$ F = 100.0000000 − 9 × 1 0 − 7 + 0 % at an instantaneous electron velocity of 270 mm s −1 . The filling of 54 quantum dots is controlled by simple atomic pulses, allowing us to swap electron patterns, laying the groundwork for a native spin-qubit SWAP gate. This T-junction establishes a path towards scalable, two-dimensional quantum computing architectures with flexible spin qubit routing for quantum error correction.

title: A sublattice polarimeter to probe the quantum geometry of synthetic photonic lattices
summary_zh: 本文提出一种子晶格偏振仪，用于探测合成光子晶格的量子几何。通过空间光调制器控制相位和衰减，提取晶体轨道的振幅和相位。
summary_en: This paper proposes a sublattice polarimeter for probing the quantum geometry of synthetic photonic lattices. By using a spatial light modulator to apply controlled phase shifts and attenuations, the amplitude and phase of crystal orbitals are extracted.
insights: 创新点：子晶格偏振仪探测量子几何
方法亮点：空间光调制器控制相位和衰减
关键发现：提取晶体轨道振幅和相位
insights_en: Novelty: Sublattice polarimeter for probing quantum geometry
Method highlight: Spatial light modulator for phase and attenuation control
Key finding: Extraction of crystal orbital amplitude and phase
abstract: Measuring the electronic structure of crystalline materials is key in advancing our understanding of their physical properties. While techniques such as angle-resolved photoemission spectroscopy have provided unprecedented insights into electronic orbitals of natural crystals, an equivalent tool to characterize photonic lattices is still lacking. Here, we introduce a sublattice polarimeter that enables full reconstruction of the Bloch wavefunctions in bipartite photonic lattices. Using a spatial light modulator to apply controlled phase shifts and attenuations to each sublattice, we extract the amplitude and phase of the crystal orbitals across the Brillouin zone, including close to band degeneracies. This allows experimentally accessing the Bloch Hamiltonian, thereby determining the quantum geometric tensor and the band Chern numbers. Beyond bipartite lattices, the method can be generalized to address multiple internal degrees of freedom, opening routes to experimentally probe complex topological structures such as trigonal warping, Chern insulators and Euler curvature in multiband settings. The authors introduce a sublattice polarimeter to measure the Bloch wavefunctions in bipartite photonic lattices. Using their method, they experimentally access the quantum metric, Berry curvature and band Chern numbers.

HENet++: Hybrid Encoding and Multi-task Learning for 3D Perception and Planning in Autonomous Driving

Open-world panoptic segmentation
summary_zh: 提出一种通用方法Con2MAV，用于开放世界全景分割。实验表明其在开放世界分割中的强大能力。
summary_en: A general method, Con2MAV, for open-world panoptic segmentation is proposed. Experiments highlight its compelling capabilities in open-world segmentation.
insights: 创新点：提出开放世界全景分割的通用方法。
方法亮点：Con2MAV方法在开放世界分割中表现优异。
关键发现：该方法在多种数据集上均表现出色。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing a general method for open-world panoptic segmentation.
Method highlight: Con2MAV performs excellently in open-world segmentation.
Key finding: The method shows compelling performance across various datasets.
abstract: Robots need to be able to understand their surroundings in order to operate safely and robustly, and to interact with the surrounding environment. Robots deployed in unconstrained real-world scenarios must additionally be able to deal with novel situations and objects that have never been seen before. In this article, we tackle the problem of open-world panoptic segmentation, that is, the task of discovering new semantic categories and new object instances at test time, while enforcing consistency among the categories that we incrementally discover. We present Con2MAV, a general method for open-world panoptic segmentation. Experiments across a wide range of datasets, from road scenes to underwater environments, highlight its compelling capabilities in open-world segmentation and its competitive performance on known classes. We will open-source the implementation of our approach upon acceptance. In addition, we propose PANIC ( P anoptic AN omalies I n C ontext), a benchmark for evaluating open-world segmentation tasks in autonomous driving scenarios. This dataset, recorded with a multi-modal sensor suite mounted on a car, and then manually annotated, provides high-quality, pixel-wise annotations of anomalous objects at both semantic and instance level. PANIC contains 800 images, more than 50 unknown classes, that is, classes that do not appear in the training set, and over 4000 object instances, providing a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating open-world segmentation methods in autonomous driving scenarios. We provide competitions for multiple open-world segmentation tasks on a hidden test set. Our dataset and competitions are available at https://www.ipb.uni-bonn.de/data/panic .

Soft robotic and computational models of left atrial hemodynamics in sinus rhythm and atrial fibrillation
summary_zh: 本文提出一种软体机器人和计算模型，用于研究心房颤动中的左心耳血流动力学。该模型结合了软体机器人模拟器和有限元分析。
summary_en: This paper presents a soft robotic and computational model for studying left atrial hemodynamics in atrial fibrillation. The model combines a soft robotic simulator and finite element analysis.
insights: 创新点：软体机器人和计算模型研究心房颤动
方法亮点：结合软体机器人模拟器和有限元分析
关键发现：模型模拟左心耳血流动力学
insights_en: Novelty: Soft robotic and computational model for studying atrial fibrillation
Method highlight: Combination of soft robotic simulator and finite element analysis
Key finding: Model simulates left atrial hemodynamics
abstract: Atrial fibrillation (AF) poses significant clinical challenges due to the complex and variable geometry of the left atrial appendage (LAA), whose structure complicates the development of personalized interventions like LAA occlusion (LAAO) for stroke prevention Current reliance on animal models and cadavers for the assessment of left atrium (LA) and LAA to study AF-related disease and interventions raises reproducibility concerns, necessitating the development of high fidelity, physiologically relevant tools. To address this, we present a multimodal framework combining a soft robotic benchtop simulator, a lumped parameter model (LPM), and finite element analysis (FEA) to replicate LA function in sinus rhythm, atrial flutter, and AF. The system integrates 3D-printed, patient-specific LA geometries with soft robotic actuators to reproduce realistic wall motion and hemodynamics. A compact, magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-compatible flow loop, driven by a soft robotic left ventricle (LV), eliminates bulky and non-physiological pulsatile pumps, allowing precise flow measurements and LAAO device testing under clinically relevant conditions. Complementary LPM and FEA models provide mechanistic insights, quantifying systemic hemodynamic changes and LA wall stress during disease and interventions. The models effectively replicate the clinical markers of atrial dysfunction and arrhythmia disorders, and their physiological accuracy is demonstrated through validation against human imaging and porcine models. The soft robotic LV's ability to drive the mock flow loop is validated in a hybrid synthetic-biological configuration within a swine circulatory system, where the soft robotic ventricle replaces native ventricular contraction to sustain systemic circulation. This scalable and versatile framework integrates experimental and computational techniques to advance cardiovascular biomechanics, supporting device development, clinical research/training, and personalized AF treatment to improve patient outcomes.

title: Optimal scenario design for climate emulation
summary_zh: 本研究提出了一种优化气候仿真的场景设计方法，通过引入可微分的简单气候模型，提高了仿真的泛化能力。
summary_en: This study introduces an optimal scenario design method for climate emulation, enhancing the generalization ability of the emulator by incorporating a differentiable simple climate model.
insights: 创新点：提出了一种优化气候仿真的场景设计方法
方法亮点：引入可微分的简单气候模型
关键发现：提高了仿真的泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Proposed an optimal scenario design method for climate emulation
Method highlight: Introduced a differentiable simple climate model
Key finding: Enhanced the generalization ability of the emulator
abstract: As deep learning for physical systems continues to grow in popularity, efforts to improve generalizability have primarily focused on designing architectures that embed physical constraints. However, for machine-learning surrogate climate models (emulators), we show that the low structural diversity in existing scenarios commonly used to generate training data places a ceiling on predictive skill. Here, we examine whether training datasets themselves can be optimized to improve generalization. We introduce a method to create datasets that produce emulators capable of generalizing to new, structurally different scenarios absent from the training data. We use a differentiable simple climate model (SCM) to calculate the sensitivity of emulator loss to perturbations in the training data, iteratively updating the training data to maximize emulator skill. For an SCM, an emulator trained on one scenario optimized in this fashion outperforms an emulator trained on six standard Scenario Model Intercomparison Project (ScenarioMIP) pathways. We achieve this higher predictive skill despite training on a smaller dataset, finding that our emulator successfully isolates distinct physical behaviors of different climate forcing agents (e.g., greenhouse gases vs. aerosols) without single-forcing runs. We then demonstrate that scenarios optimized using an SCM, when used to drive an intermediate-complexity climate model, produce a training dataset that yields a more skillful emulator than training on ScenarioMIP outputs. Our results suggest that, in the compute-constrained environment of running full-scale climate models, generating a small number of dynamically rich scenarios provides greater marginal value for emulation and characterizing system responses than expanding the suite of traditional emissions pathways.

title: Decoherence resilience of the non-Hermitian skin effect
summary_zh: 研究非厄米皮肤效应的相干性。实验采用光子量子行走。结果表明非厄米皮肤效应在去相位下可维持。
summary_en: Investigates the coherence resilience of the non-Hermitian skin effect. Experiments use photonic quantum walks. Results indicate the skin effect persists under dephasing.
insights: 创新点：非厄米皮肤效应在去相位下的相干性研究
方法亮点：利用光子量子行走实验
关键发现：非厄米皮肤效应在去相位下可维持
insights_en: Novelty: Coherence resilience of non-Hermitian skin effect under dephasing
Method highlight: Utilizing photonic quantum walk experiments
Key finding: Skin effect persists under dephasing
abstract: Decoherence and dissipation, arising from interactions with the environment, can exert a dual influence on transport in physical systems, suppressing coherent propagation while inducing diffusion and mitigating localization in disordered systems. Non-Hermitian physics offers a distinct scenario, where structured dissipation induces directional bulk-to-boundary transport, known as the non-Hermitian skin effect. Whether such transport can persist, be enhanced, or hindered under decoherence remains a largely open question. Here we experimentally address this question using photonic quantum walks with two tunable prototypical decoherence channels, dephasing and amplitude damping. Under dephasing, the non-Hermitian skin effect survives up to the fully incoherent regime and is observed to even be enhanced by dephasing, yielding drift velocities that exceed those of coherent dynamics. By contrast, amplitude damping shows a pronounced order dependence: applied before the non-Hermitian loss operator, it suppresses and ultimately eliminates the non-Hermitian skin effect in the fully incoherent limit; applied afterward, the non-Hermitian skin effect persists and can be enhanced at sufficiently large loss strengths. Our work bridges quantum and classical non-Hermitian dynamics, demonstrates the resilience of the non-Hermitian skin effect to decoherence, and opens avenues for harnessing decoherence to enhance directional transport in noisy, nonequilibrium systems. Decoherence, often viewed as detrimental to coherent transport, can instead enhance the non-Hermitian skin effect, which persists into the fully incoherent regime. Its effect can be tuned by the type and implementation of decoherence.

Modified Newtonian Dynamics and galaxy clusters
summary_zh: 研究探讨了修改牛顿动力学（MOND）在解释星系团平衡中的作用。
summary_en: This study explores the role of Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) in explaining the equilibrium of galaxy clusters.
insights: 创新点：提出MOND可能解释星系团的暗物质问题
方法亮点：结合MOND和星系团观测数据进行分析
关键发现：MOND可能减少星系团的暗物质需求
insights_en: Novelty: Suggested that MOND may explain the dark matter problem in galaxy clusters
Method highlight: Analyzed data combining MOND and galaxy cluster observations
Key finding: MOND may reduce the dark matter requirement in galaxy clusters
abstract: First proposed by Milgrom in 1983 as an alternative to the standard Cold Dark Matter (CDM) paradigm, Modified Newtonian Dynamics (MOND) has gained renewed momentum in light of persistent nondetections of exotic dark matter particles and growing tensions facing CDM on galactic scales. While MOND perfectly reproduces galactic rotation curves, it encounters notable challenges in explaining the equilibrium of galaxy clusters. Although it reduces the overall dark matter budget in these massive systems, an unidentified mass component remains required. This paper investigates the hypothesis that this missing mass is baryonic: composed of nonradiating ordinary matter such as stellar remnants, gas too diffuse to initiate star formation, or compact, ultra-dense clouds of cold molecular gas with low volume filling factors. Using a sample of 106 clusters mapped in X-rays, emitted by the hot intracluster medium composing most of the visible mass, we derive first the total mass within the Newtonian dynamics, assuming hydrostatic equilibrium and spherical symmetry. Then, with the modified Poisson equation, we reconstruct the spatial distribution of the invisible missing matter within the MOND framework. In the sample, the relaxed systems harboring cooling flows, known as cool-core clusters, have the highest peaks of dark missing mass. Its density profile reveals a pronounced central concentration bounded by a steep truncation immediately beyond a core radius of 20 to 30 kpc, confirming previous studies. MOND reduces the necessary dynamical mass by a factor of 4 to 10. The residual missing mass is proportional to the total gas mass, being roughly twice lower.

Towards ecologically meaningful foundation models
summary_zh: 提出生态基础模型，整合数据与理论。生态数据集训练。机器学习挑战。
summary_en: Proposes ecological foundation models, integrating data and theory. Trains on large, multi-modal ecological datasets. Presents a challenge for machine learning.
insights: 创新点：生态基础模型的提出
方法亮点：基于生态数据集训练
关键发现：对机器学习的挑战
insights_en: Novelty: Proposal of ecological foundation models
Method highlight: Training on large, multi-modal ecological datasets
Key finding: Challenge for machine learning
abstract: Ecology aims to explain and predict how organisms interact with each other and their environments across space and time. Yet both ecological data and theory are fragmented, leading to models that generalize poorly beyond specific systems or scales. Empirical evidence spans diverse modalities, resolutions and contexts, while theory is distributed across partially overlapping frameworks that are rarely integrated within a single predictive model. We argue that ecological foundation models (ecoFMs), trained on large, multi-modal ecological datasets and informed by ecological theory, offer a route towards unifying data and theory within a common framework. Beyond their scientific value for ecology, ecoFMs present a challenging and consequential testbed for machine learning, demanding advances in multi-modal representation learning, theory-guided modelling and uncertainty-aware inference. By learning shared representations of organisms, environments and interactions, ecoFMs could improve generalization, link pattern to process and enable synthesis across ecological subdisciplines. We outline a roadmap for developing ecoFMs, including requirements for data infrastructure, model architectures, evaluation strategies and governance, and assess where current machine learning and ecological approaches fall short. If developed responsibly and collaboratively with ecological practitioners and other actors, ecoFMs could enable new modes of analysis and strengthen ecological forecasting, while simultaneously driving advances in machine learning for multi-modal integration, theory-guided learning and generalization in complex, data-limited systems. Ecology struggles to make broad predictions, as ecological data and theories are scattered across many different sources, scales and approaches. Gardiner et al. propose to create ecological foundation models, which combine large, multi-modal ecological datasets with ecological theory, as a way to create more generalizable and predictive models.

Forcing dataset updates impact regional but not global Earth radiation budget trends in the GFDL AM4 climate model
summary_zh: 研究评估了使用更新后的强迫数据集对模拟辐射收支的影响。方法上，使用CMIP7强迫数据集进行系统评估。实验表明，更新后的强迫数据集未改善模拟全球平均顶空气辐射趋势与卫星观测趋势的一致性。
summary_en: This study evaluates the impact of using updated forcing datasets on simulated radiation budgets. The method involves a systematic evaluation using the newly released CMIP7 forcing dataset. Experiments show that the updated forcing dataset does not improve the agreement between the simulated global-mean top-of-the-atmosphere radiation trends and satellite-observed trends.
insights: 创新点：评估更新后的强迫数据集对模拟辐射收支的影响
方法亮点：使用CMIP7强迫数据集进行系统评估
关键发现：更新后的强迫数据集未改善模拟全球平均顶空气辐射趋势与卫星观测趋势的一致性
insights_en: Novelty: Evaluating the impact of updated forcing datasets on simulated radiation budgets
Method highlight: Systematic evaluation using the CMIP7 forcing dataset
Key finding: The updated forcing dataset does not improve the agreement between the simulated global-mean top-of-the-atmosphere radiation trends and satellite-observed trends
abstract: Abstract The availability of up-to-date forcing datasets is critical for reconciling Earth system model simulations with contemporary observations. With the newly released CMIP7 forcing dataset, which extends the historical record through 2021, this study provides the first systematic evaluation of how using updated forcings over the “middle-of-the-road” SSP2-4.5 scenario forcings influences the simulated radiation budget. The updated forcing dataset used in the atmosphere model does not improve the agreement between the simulated global-mean top-of-the-atmosphere radiation trends and the satellite-observed trends. Regionally, we identify pronounced shifts in radiative energy partitioning between atmosphere and surface. Specifically, during 2001 ~ 2021, accelerated reductions in sulfate and black carbon aerosols over East Asia drive a significant decline in atmospheric solar absorption that matches observations, while a substantial increase in organic aerosols at higher latitudes induces a localized increase in atmospheric absorption that does not match observations. The substantial influence of localized forcing changes on simulated regional climate underscores the necessity for routine updates of forcing datasets.

title: Multifunctional multiphysics metamaterials via decomposition-based multiobjective optimization design
summary_zh: 研究提出分解式多目标优化设计框架，解决多功能多物理场超材料设计难题。方法上，采用动态归一化探索Pareto前沿。结果表明，优化设计有效实现功能优先级选择。
summary_en: This study proposes a decomposition-based multiobjective optimization framework to address the challenges in designing multifunctional multiphysics metamaterials. The method employs dynamic normalization to uniformly explore the Pareto front. Results show that the optimized design effectively achieves the selection of functional priorities.
insights: 创新点：分解式多目标优化设计框架
方法亮点：动态归一化探索Pareto前沿
关键发现：优化设计实现功能优先级选择
insights_en: Novelty: Decomposition-based multiobjective optimization design framework
Method highlight: Dynamic normalization to explore the Pareto front
Key finding: Optimized design achieves functional priority selection
abstract: Metamaterials offer unprecedented control over physical fields through their microstructure, but current design methods cannot meet the demands of scenarios involving active sources, multiphysics field coupling, and multifunctional requirements. Moreover, existing approaches are generally developed for specific functions, making it difficult to integrate different functionalities and select the functional priorities within a single structure. To overcome these limitations, this study presents a systematic inverse design framework for multifunctional multiphysics metamaterials via multiobjective optimization. To uniformly explore the Pareto front, which clearly exhibits trade-offs among functionalities and facilitates the selection of functional priorities, we employ dynamic normalization into the decomposition-based multiobjective evolutionary algorithm. A robust anisotropic unit-cell database is constructed and used for generating metamaterials with optimized microstructures for multifunctionality. Three complex cases are studied that can simultaneously achieve mechanical cloaking plus stress minimization, thermal cloaking plus stress minimization, and direct current cloaking plus thermal stress minimization. Furthermore, the proposed framework is employed in potential engineering problems, for example, to realize mechanical cloaking by embedding functional components in structural materials, while minimizing the surrounding stress on functional components for mechanical protection when the assembled structures are compressed, thereby decoupling the interaction between functional and structural components. This systematic framework expands the capabilities of metamaterials in complex multiphysics coupling, offering a robust blueprint for future intelligent, structurally and functionally integrated systems.

title: Melting and resistivity of iron at Earth core conditions using pulsed Joule heating
summary_zh: 本文使用脉冲焦耳加热法研究地球核心条件下铁的熔点和电阻率。发现熔点较低，核心-外核边界温度较低。
summary_en: This paper investigates the melting temperature and electrical resistivity of iron at Earth's core conditions using pulsed Joule heating. It finds a surprisingly shallow melting curve and a relatively cold core-mantle boundary temperature.
insights: 创新点：使用脉冲焦耳加热法研究地球核心条件。
方法亮点：提供铁熔点和电阻率的新数据。
关键发现：地球核心温度较低。
insights_en: Novelty: Investigating Earth's core conditions using pulsed Joule heating.
Method highlight: Providing new data on iron melting temperature and resistivity.
Key finding: The Earth's core is relatively cold.
abstract: The melting temperature and electrical resistivity of iron at high pressure are essential for understanding Earth’s core. Here we use a new high-pressure method – microsecond pulsed Joule heating in diamond anvil cells – to identify melting and measure resistivity of solid and liquid iron. More than 300 reproducible melting measurements indicate a surprisingly shallow melting curve, reaching 6 K/GPa and 4160 ± 80 K at 200 GPa. Extrapolating in pressure and iron alloy composition, and combining with our 76 μ Ω cm measurement of liquid iron’s resistivity, we infer a relatively cold core-mantle boundary (3430 K) with a low adiabatic outer core heat flow (9.8 TW). This suggests thermal convection alone could have powered the geodynamo prior to inner core formation and that today’s lowermost mantle is fully solid.

title: Coevolution of social network structure and life history in toothed whales
summary_zh: 研究齿鲸的社会网络结构与生活史的协同进化，分析社会网络特征与生活史数据。
summary_en: Examining the coevolution of social network structure and life history in toothed whales, analyzing social network traits and life history data.
insights: 创新点：分析齿鲸社会网络与生活史的协同进化
方法亮点：应用社会网络分析与系统发育模型
关键发现：社会网络特征与生活史相关联
insights_en: Novelty: Analyzing the coevolution of social network and life history in toothed whales
Method highlight: Applying social network analysis and phylogenetic models
Key finding: Social network traits associated with life history
abstract: Toothed whales offer a 34 My-long natural experiment for the evolution of complex mammalian societies. However, quantitative comparative analyses of social structure in these species are lacking. Here, we draw on existing social network analyses to compare social structure across toothed whales. We consider published measures of two social network traits across all toothed whales: modularity ( Q ), which captures divisions or “cliques” in a social community, and social differentiation ( S ), which estimates how much whales vary in their relationships—whether they associate equally with others or form special bonds with specific individuals. Combining these with a recently published database of life history traits, we applied phylogenetic multilevel models with the objective of exploring the origins of social network structure. We identified 98 measures of modularity and 89 measures of social differentiation from 23 toothed whale species. Social network structure was more similar among closely related species (showing strong phylogenetic signal), despite substantial intraspecific variability. Toothed whales with longer lifespans and larger bodies tended to form more modular social networks, as did those where males were proportionally larger than females. Similar but weaker patterns were found between life history traits and social differentiation. Results from causal coevolutionary models provide preliminary evidence that social structure has been both a leader and follower of changes in life history. Our findings reveal the correlated evolution of social network structure and life history traits in toothed whales, shedding new light on the origins of social relationships.

summary_zh: 提出一种基于物理的新方法用于星光抑制。解决望远镜稳定性问题。有望增加直接成像行星数量。
summary_en: A new physics-based method for starlight subtraction is proposed. It addresses the issue of telescope stability and could increase the number of planets amenable to direct imaging.
insights: 创新点：基于物理的星光抑制方法
方法亮点：解决望远镜稳定性问题
关键发现：增加直接成像行星数量
insights_en: Novelty: Physics-based starlight subtraction method
Method highlight: Resolving telescope stability issues
Key finding: Increasing the number of planets amenable to direct imaging
abstract: Abstract Exoplanet imaging is the main method for detailed characterization of planets orbiting beyond 1 au (ref. 1 ) but it requires suppressing the bright glare of the star to see the faint planet light. As well as sophisticated instrumentation 2,3 , effective image processing is necessary for starlight suppression, which continues to be a substantial limitation 4 . Standard algorithms use reference images for starlight modelling and thus they are limited by inevitable telescope instabilities that change from reference to science observation 5,6 . Addressing this challenge will increase the number of planets amenable to direct imaging and will be a notable step towards imaging exo-Earths with future observatories 7 . Here we present a new physics-based method for starlight subtraction. Our method combines a multistep optimization with a flexible physical model to produce a starlight model, allowing modelling and compensation of instrument instabilities. We use automatic differentiation (autodiff) 8 to optimize millions of model parameters. We demonstrate our method on observations from the James Webb Space Telescope (JWST) Near-InfraRed Camera (NIRCam) 9–11 coronagraph instrument. We achieve sensitivity 2–15 times superior to standard techniques, including the first detection of 51 Eridani b (ref. 12 ) at 4.3 μm. This is the first time, to our knowledge, that such an approach has demonstrated substantially improved sensitivity on real, on-sky coronagraphic imaging. Our framework can be extended to other current and future ground-based and space-based observatories, including the Nancy Grace Roman Space Telescope and the Habitable Worlds Observatory (HWO), potentially relaxing the unprecedented stability requirements needed to make these a success.

title: X-ray stopwatch can measure durations of just attoseconds
summary_zh: 测量170阿秒的X射线脉冲持续时间。系统可用于测量原子和分子内电子的快速运动。
summary_en: The duration of 170 attosecond X-ray pulses is measured. The system can be used to measure the rapid motion of electrons inside atoms and molecules.
insights: 创新点：测量170阿秒的X射线脉冲
方法亮点：用于测量原子和分子内电子运动
关键发现：系统精度高
insights_en: Novelty: Measuring 170 attosecond X-ray pulses
Method highlight: Used for measuring electron motion inside atoms and molecules
Key finding: High precision of the system
abstract: The duration of short ångström-wavelength X-ray pulses, which lasted merely 170 attoseconds, has finally been measured accurately. The optical system designed for precision pulse duration metrology can be used as a ‘stopwatch’ to measure the rapid motion of electrons inside atoms and molecules, too. Short pulses generated by the system could be used to observe electrons moving around atomic nuclei.

A physics-based model enables the observation of exoplanets that were undetectable using standard techniques.

summary_zh: 提出利用地理空间数据测量经济活动的方法。结合工厂产出数据与地理空间数据，训练机器学习模型预测工厂位置与产出。模型准确识别大部分工厂，并可靠测量钢铁产量。
summary_en: Proposes a method for measuring economic activity using geospatial data. Combines plant output data with geospatial data to train machine learning models for predicting plant locations and output. The model accurately identifies most plants and reliably measures steel production.
insights: 创新点：地理空间数据结合机器学习预测经济活动
方法亮点：高精度预测工厂位置与产出
关键发现：模型适用于不同地区钢铁产量测量
insights_en: Novelty: Integrating geospatial data with machine learning to predict economic activity
Method highlight: High-precision prediction of plant locations and output
Key finding: Model applicable for measuring steel production in different regions
abstract: Abstract We introduce a methodology to detect and measure economic activity using geospatial data and apply it to steel production, a major industrial pollution source worldwide. Combining plant output data with geospatial data, such as ambient air pollutants, nighttime lights, and temperature, we train machine learning models to predict plant locations and output. We identify about 88% (94%) of plants missing from the training sample within a 1 km (5 km) radius and achieve R 2 above 0.8 for output prediction at a 1 km grid and at the plant level, as well as both regional and time series validations. We use the model trained on Chinese steel data to reliably detect the location and measure the total annual output of steel plants in South Korea and Iran. Our approach can be adapted to other industries and regions, and used by policymakers and researchers to track and measure industrial activity in near real time.

title: Redundancy maximization as a principle of associative memory learning in Hopfield networks
summary_zh: 运用信息理论分析Hopfield网络中的局部信息处理。发现信息冗余最大化是关联记忆学习的关键原则。
summary_en: Applies information theory to analyze local information processing in Hopfield networks. Finds that redundancy maximization is a key principle of associative memory learning.
insights: 创新点：信息理论应用于Hopfield网络
方法亮点：局部信息处理分析
关键发现：冗余最大化原则
insights_en: Novelty: Information theory applied to Hopfield networks
Method highlight: Analysis of local information processing
Key finding: Redundancy maximization principle
abstract: Abstract Associative memory, traditionally modeled by Hopfield networks, enables the retrieval of previously stored patterns from partial or noisy cues. Yet, the local computational principles which are required to enable this function remain incompletely understood. To formally characterize the local information processing in such systems, we employ a recent extension of information theory—Partial Information Decomposition. It decomposes the contribution of different inputs to an output into unique information from each input, redundant information across inputs, and synergistic information that emerges from combining different inputs. Applying this framework to individual neurons in classical Hopfield networks we find that below the memory capacity, the information in a neuron’s activity is characterized by high redundancy between the external pattern input and the internal recurrent input, while synergy and unique information are close to zero until the memory capacity is surpassed and performance drops steeply. Inspired by this observation, we use redundancy maximization at each neuron as an information-theoretic learning goal. This increases the network’s memory capacity to 1.59, a more than tenfold improvement over the 0.14 capacity of classical Hopfield networks, and also outperforming recent state-of-the-art implementations of Hopfield networks. Overall, this work establishes redundancy maximization as a design principle for associative memories and opens pathways for new associative memory models based on information-theoretic goals.

title: A topographic video model predicts the spatio-functional organization of the human visual system
summary_zh: 构建了一种拓扑视频模型，预测人类视觉系统的空间功能组织。该方法将神经网络单元在模拟皮质片上排列和转换，捕捉视觉系统的高级选择性。
summary_en: A topographic video model is constructed to predict the spatio-functional organization of the human visual system. This method arranges and transforms neural network units onto a simulated cortical sheet, capturing the system's high-level selectivity.
insights: 创新点：构建了预测人类视觉系统空间功能组织的拓扑视频模型
方法亮点：将神经网络单元在模拟皮质片上排列和转换
关键发现：捕捉了视觉系统的高级选择性
insights_en: Novelty: Constructed a topographic video model to predict the spatial functional organization of the human visual system
Method highlight: Arranges and transforms neural network units onto a simulated cortical sheet
Key finding: Captured the system's high-level selectivity
abstract: Abstract The human brain organizes visual processing into spatially structured functional clusters. Recent topographic neural networks model category-selective clusters but are limited to static images and ventral cortex. In this work, we model the topographic organization of dynamic visual representations across high-level visual cortex. We introduce a general method that spatially arranges and transforms units from a neural network onto a simulated cortical sheet. Applied to a pretrained video foundation model, the method produces spatially structured response correlations while preserving task performance and brain alignment. It captures ventral and dorsal clusters, including face-, body-, and motion-selective patches, and reflects system-level selectivity distributions for animacy, object size, and static versus dynamic content. Functional selectivity varies smoothly across both model and human tissue, suggesting predominantly general-purpose cortical processing with continuous transitions into local functional clusters. Taken together, we provide a computational framework for understanding the spatial and functional organization of high-level visual cortex.

Fractal basin geometry and the limits to predictability and reproducibility in deep learning
summary_zh: 本文提出使用充满孔洞的盆地几何形状来解释深度学习中预测和可重复性的限制。发现初始化精度提高对结果影响有限。
summary_en: This paper proposes using riddled basin geometry to explain the limits of predictability and reproducibility in deep learning. It finds that even sharp increases in initialization precision yield only marginal gains in outcome.
insights: 创新点：提出新的动态系统机制解释深度学习中的预测限制。
方法亮点：使用神经网络模型进行理论分析。
关键发现：初始化精度对结果影响有限。
insights_en: Novelty: A new dynamical systems mechanism is proposed to explain predictability limits in deep learning.
Method highlight: Theoretical analysis using a neural network model.
Key finding: Initialization precision has limited impact on outcomes.
abstract: Abstract Fundamental limits to predictability are central to our understanding of many physical and computational systems. In deep learning, training outcomes are often difficult to predict and reproduce even when extrinsic sources of randomness are controlled, yet the underlying mechanism remains unclear. Here we propose riddled basin geometry as a unifying dynamical systems mechanism: every initialization leading to one solution lies arbitrarily close to initializations leading to different solutions, forming a fat fractal with structure at arbitrarily fine scales. Using a minimal neural network model, we analytically establish the classical route to riddling and derive a near-zero uncertainty exponent: even sharp increases in initialization precision yield only marginal gains in outcome predictability. In deep networks, intertwined training destinations and near-zero parameter-space exponents provide robust signatures consistent with riddling across the tested architectures, optimizers and training protocols, offering a common dynamical account of otherwise disparate empirical observations. We further introduce functional uncertainty exponents, extending these diagnostics of scale-insensitive irreproducibility from parameter space to the learned functions themselves. Together, our results support riddled basin geometry as a candidate organizing principle for irreproducibility in deep learning, with practical implications for optimization and the reliable deployment of artificial intelligence.

title: The deep Earth origin of the Great Unconformity
summary_zh: 本文研究大不整合的深部地球起源。发现大陆尺度抬升和沉降导致大不整合的形成和保存。
summary_en: This paper investigates the deep Earth origin of the Great Unconformity. It finds that continental-scale uplift and subsidence led to the formation and preservation of the Great Unconformity.
insights: 创新点：提出大陆抬升和沉降导致大不整合的形成。
方法亮点：使用动态地形模型研究大不整合。
关键发现：大不整合与地幔对流有关。
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing that continental uplift and subsidence led to the formation of the Great Unconformity.
Method highlight: Using dynamic topography models to study the Great Unconformity.
Key finding: The Great Unconformity is related to mantle convection.
abstract: Abstract The Great Unconformity marks a globally extensive erosive surface linked to climatic shifts 1 and environmental transitions 2 that preceded the Cambrian explosion of life. The processes proposed to explain the formation of the Great Unconformity include glacial erosion during the Snowball Earth 1,3,4 , rifting and plume activity 5–7 , sea-level fall 8 and mantle-driven dynamic topography 6,9–11 . However, the dynamics of these processes have not been tested. Here we show that continental-scale uplift and subsidence associated with long-wavelength dynamic topography 12 due to mantle convection drove the formation and preservation of the Great Unconformity. Our models predict prolonged continental-scale Neoproterozoic uplift and long-term Phanerozoic subsidence for Laurentia, Baltica and North China. This vertical motion scenario is ideal for the formation and preservation of the Great Unconformity, which is a first-order surface expression of deep Earth processes. The predicted prolonged continental uplift throughout Cryogenian times would have resulted in marked erosion due to the action of glaciers 13 . The large area of Laurentia and limited deformation at its margins explain why the Great Unconformity is best preserved and documented there. Our models predict cycles of dynamic topography that are broadly reflected in preserved sediment volume across continents 1,14 , and open new avenues for understanding the environments of Cambrian animal diversification.

title: Towards observing interstitial hydrogen in solution in metal lattices
summary_zh: 本文研究金属晶格中溶液氢的观察。使用原子探针断层扫描技术，区分溶液氢和缺陷捕获氢。
summary_en: This paper investigates the observation of interstitial hydrogen in solution within metal lattices. It uses atom probe tomography to distinguish solution hydrogen from defect-trapped hydrogen.
insights: 创新点：使用原子探针断层扫描技术观察溶液氢。
方法亮点：使用氘作为氢的替代物。
关键发现：区分溶液氢和缺陷捕获氢。
insights_en: Novelty: Using atom probe tomography to observe solution hydrogen.
Method highlight: Using deuterium as a proxy for hydrogen.
Key finding: Distinguishing solution hydrogen from defect-trapped hydrogen.
abstract: Abstract Hydrogen-bearing materials are central to low-carbon energy technologies 1 , but hydrogen itself is difficult to detect and localize at the nanoscale 2–6 . This hinders the development of advanced materials with better efficiency. Atom probe tomography (APT) can map hydrogen in three dimensions and at high resolution, yet characterization of dilute, mobile, interstitial hydrogen in metals has remained challenging because of low solubility, the ambiguity owing to hydrogen trapping by structural defects, as well as the artefacts introduced during hydrogen introduction 4–6 . Here we address whether interstitial hydrogen in solution in materials can be distinguished from defect-trapped hydrogen in APT. Using deuterium as a proxy for hydrogen, together with face-centred cubic (FCC) multi-principal-element alloys (MPEAs) containing coherent FCC precipitates, we show that deuterium atoms reproducibly concentrate in hydrogen-affinitive phases in a manner consistent with theoretical predictions. We further resolve differences in deuterium content between phases with distinct local chemistries and crystal structures, consistent with their different calculated hydrogen solution energies. These findings demonstrate that APT can move beyond identifying hydrides and solute-decorated defects to examine hydrogen in solid solution, providing new insights into hydrogen partitioning in structural alloys and informing materials design for hydrogen-related applications.

title: Bootstrap Your Own AV-Proxies: Adaptive Contrastive and Prototype Learning for Audio-Visual Segmentation
summary_zh: 研究提出自适应对比学习和原型学习框架，用于音频-视觉分割，解决语义不完整和语义差距问题。
summary_en: This study proposes an adaptive contrastive and prototype learning framework for audio-visual segmentation to address issues of semantic incompleteness and semantic gap.
insights: 创新点：提出自适应对比学习和原型学习框架解决音频-视觉分割问题
方法亮点：设计自监督音频增强模块引入对比学习
关键发现：提高音频-视觉分割的准确性和泛化能力
insights_en: Novelty: Proposing an adaptive contrastive and prototype learning framework to solve audio-visual segmentation problems
Method highlight: Designing a self-supervised audio enhancement module that introduces contrastive learning
Key finding: Improving the accuracy and generalization ability of audio-visual segmentation
abstract: Audio-Visual Segmentation (AVS) aims to accurately segment sounding objects in video frames by leveraging audio-visual correspondence cues. However, it remains challenging due to the intrinsic semantic incompleteness within a single modality and the semantic gap between audio and visual representations. Traditional feature-fusion decoding approaches struggle to suppress fusion noise effectively, while recent methods that incorporate data-dependent priors often increase the complexity of modeling audio-visual correlations, leading to poor cross-domain generalization. To address these issues, we propose a novel adaptive contrastive and prototype learning framework, BYOAVP, for AVS. Specifically, we design a Self-Supervised Audio Enhancement (SSAE) module that introduces contrastive learning to adaptively align audio representations with gradient-blocked visual embeddings, thus narrowing the semantic gap between modalities. Furthermore, a Dynamic Prototype Constraint (DPC) module is developed to refine pixel-wise category perception via momentum-based prototype updating, while enhancing localization of sounding regions through cross-modal interaction. Extensive experiments demonstrate that our method achieves SOTA performance across two AVS benchmarks and six sub-tasks, exhibiting strong robustness and generalization ability.

LLM ensemble PREVIA predicts future PTSD risk from emergency department trauma narratives with expert-level accuracy
summary_zh: 研究引入PREVIA模型，通过分析急诊科创伤叙事预测创伤后应激障碍风险。模型从患者创伤叙事中提取早期创伤症状、创伤相关症状、风险和保护因素。
summary_en: This study introduces the PREVIA model, which predicts future PTSD risk from emergency department trauma narratives with expert-level accuracy. The model extracts early post-traumatic stress symptoms, peri-traumatic symptoms, risk, and protective factors from unstructured patient trauma narratives.
insights: 创新点：PREVIA模型预测PTSD风险
方法亮点：分析创伤叙事
关键发现：早期症状识别
insights_en: Novelty: PREVIA model predicts PTSD risk
Method highlight: Analysis of trauma narratives
Key finding: Identification of early symptoms
abstract: Post-traumatic stress disorder affects numerous trauma survivors following emergency department discharge, making this encounter vital for early risk stratification. Yet emergency clinicians face severe time constraints, making existing screening tools impractical. We introduce PREVIA, a clinically-informed large language model ensemble, that predicts post-traumatic stress disorder risk from unstructured patient trauma narratives, collected in response to a routine-care question asked in the emergency department, by extracting early post-traumatic stress symptoms, peri-traumatic symptoms, risk, and protective factors. Within an ongoing longitudinal study, we included N = 145 patients across two New York City level-1 trauma centers within 24 hours of trauma and assessed post-traumatic stress disorder 1-month post-trauma. In this work, PREVIA accurately forecasts post-traumatic stress disorder (AUROC = 78.49% ± 5.75%, sensitivity=95.4% ± 3.99%, precision=46.76% ± 8.66%), performs comparably to an emergency clinician specialized in post-traumatic stress disorder on 30 randomly selected patients (PREVIA: AUROC = 84.39%, sensitivity=100.00%, precision=50.00%; clinician: AUROC = 83.86%, sensitivity=88.89%, precision=50.00%), and generates interpretable explanations without additional clinical burden. These initial findings support PREVIA’s potential as a scalable emergency department screener for timely, targeted interventions, and warrant validation in larger, independent cohorts. PTSD screening is rarely feasible in busy emergency departments. Here, the authors show that a scalable AI ensemble can predict 1-month PTSD risk from a single routine-care question, a first step toward low-burden implementation at point of care.

title: Electrode-associated growth reveals structure of OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires in anaerobic methanotrophic archaea
summary_zh: 研究通过电极培养揭示厌氧产甲烷古菌中OmcZ型细胞色素纳米线的结构。培养在电极上获得近无污染培养物，揭示了其生理特性和结构。
summary_en: This study reveals the structure of OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires in anaerobic methanotrophic archaea through electrode cultivation. Near-axenic cultures are obtained on electrodes, revealing their physiological properties and structure.
insights: 创新点：电极培养揭示纳米线结构
方法亮点：近无污染培养物获得
关键发现：生理特性和结构
insights_en: Novelty: Electrode cultivation reveals nanowire structure
Method highlight: Acquisition of near-axenic cultures
Key finding: Physiological properties and structure
abstract: Abstract Anaerobic methanotrophic (ANME) archaea are key regulators of methane emissions in anoxic environments, yet their physiology remains poorly understood due to the lack of axenic cultures. Here, we show that cultivation on poised electrodes yields near-axenic cultures (95.8% relative abundance) of a freshwater ANME, for which we propose the name ‘ Candidatus Methanoperedens vercellensis’. We identified key physiological properties of ‘ Ca . M. vercellensis’: doubling times of 4.6 days at 30 °C, menaquinone as respiratory electron carrier, the inability to oxidize ethane, and preferential reduction of iron oxides over nitrate after cultivation on electrodes. A 3.3 Å cryo-electron microscopy structure of filaments displayed on the archaeal surface revealed polymerized OmcZ-type cytochrome nanowires, which are homologous to OmcZ nanowires essential for long-range (>10 μm) extracellular electron transfer (EET) in Geobacter sulfurreducens . The archaeal OmcZ-type nanowires include dense, collinear stacking of protected hemesakin to bacterial OmcZ nanowires, but with post-translational modification, thus yielding morphology distinct from bacterial OmcZ nanowires. Notably, in contrast to bacterial OmcZ, archaeal OmcZ-type nanowires do not form interconnected networks, and hemes are less solvent-exposed, which can protect them from the environment. Surprisingly, these archaea assemble OmcZ into nanowires even in the apparent absence of prolyl isomerase involved in folding bacterial OmcZ. This work establishes a model system for molecular understanding of nanowire-mediated EET in archaea.

title: Absolute quantification and profiling of cellular tRNAs by nanopore sequencing and a deep learning classifier
summary_zh: 本文开发纳米孔测序与深度学习模型，用于细胞tRNA的绝对定量与鉴定。模型直接利用纳米孔信号，准确率达98.2%。实验验证了模型在tRNA鉴定中的有效性。
summary_en: This paper develops a nanopore sequencing and deep learning model for absolute quantification and profiling of cellular tRNAs. The model directly utilizes nanopore signals with 98.2% accuracy, validated by experiments for its effectiveness in tRNA identification.
insights: 创新点：直接利用纳米孔信号进行tRNA鉴定
方法亮点：深度学习模型提高tRNA鉴定准确率
关键发现：模型在多种tRNA物种中表现优异
insights_en: Novelty: Direct identification of tRNAs using nanopore signals
Method highlight: Deep learning model enhances tRNA identification accuracy
Key finding: Model excels in various tRNA species
abstract: Transfer RNAs (tRNAs) link mRNA codons to amino acids during translation. Their abundance and modification states are dynamically regulated and influence translation efficiency, mRNA stability, and proteostasis. Accurate profiling of tRNAs is essential, but deep sequencing suffers from modification-induced biases during cDNA synthesis, while nanopore direct RNA sequencing (DRS) still faces challenges in accurate tRNA profiling. Here, we develop an end-to-end deep learning model, termed nano tRNA classifier, that directly uses nanopore-DRS ionic current signals to classify tRNAs without basecalling. The model achieves 98.2% classification accuracy with high read retention across all Escherichia coli tRNA species. Using an equimolar mixture of native tRNAs as a ground-truth reference, we correct read-count bias, enabling absolute quantification and profiling under diverse culture conditions. We further develop binary classifiers that detect specific tRNA modifications at the single-molecule level with high accuracy. This nanopore-based platform integrates accurate tRNA classification, absolute quantification, and single-molecule modification detection. Here the authors develop a nanopore-based method using deep learning to classify cellular tRNAs, quantify their absolute abundance, and detect chemical modifications at the single molecule level.

title: Hydration water drives elastin’s entropic elasticity
summary_zh: 本文通过模拟研究，发现水分子的熵变是弹性蛋白弹性的主要驱动力。拉伸过程中，水分子的重新排列导致熵变降低，从而影响弹性。
summary_en: This study finds through simulations that the entropy change of hydration water is the main driving force for elastin's entropic elasticity. During stretching, the rearrangement of water molecules leads to a decrease in entropy, affecting elasticity.
insights: 创新点：揭示水分子的熵变在弹性蛋白中的作用
方法亮点：多微秒全原子模拟研究
关键发现：水分子的重新排列影响弹性
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing the role of hydration water's entropy in elastin
Method highlight: Multi-microsecond all-atom simulations
Key finding: Water rearrangement affects elasticity
abstract: Elastin endows arteries, skin and lungs with elasticity, yet the molecular origin of its entropic recoil remains debated. Using multi-microsecond all-atom simulations of a representative elastomeric region of human tropoelastin, the monomeric precursor of elastin, we quantify protein conformational entropy, hydration-water entropy, and protein- and water-mediated interaction enthalpies during stretching. Protein conformational entropy decreases modestly overall, with heterogeneous local entropic responses governed by secondary structure and sequence context. In contrast, hydration water provides the dominant unfavorable entropic contribution because stretching recruits many water molecules from bulk into a persistently low-entropy first hydration layer. Stretching also disrupts favorable intra-protein interactions while strengthening protein–water interactions, producing opposing enthalpic contributions that largely compensate the entropic penalty. Together, these results support a hydration-coupled thermodynamic mechanism in which water is the dominant entropic contributor to elastin recoil within a strongly compensating enthalpy–entropy balance. Elastin endows biological tissues with their remarkable elasticity, yet the molecular basis of its recoil has long remained unresolved. By simulating a representative elastomeric region of monomeric tropoelastin, and quantifying both protein conformational entropy and hydrationwater entropy, the authors provide an atomistic comparison of their respective contributions to elasticity. Their analysis reveals that hydration water is the dominant entropic driver of elastin recoil, acting within a finely balanced thermodynamic framework that governs stretch-induced molecular responses.

title: Correlative nanoscale chemical imaging reveals delocalized Faradaic processes at isolated MXene flakes
summary_zh: 本文利用扫描X射线显微镜和扫描电化学显微镜，揭示了MXene薄片上的电化学反应。研究发现，MXene薄片具有独特的电化学活性。
summary_en: This paper uses scanning X-ray microscopy and scanning electrochemical microscopy to reveal electrochemical reactions on MXene flakes. The study finds that MXene flakes have unique electrochemical activity.
insights: 创新点：纳米尺度化学成像揭示MXene薄片上的电化学反应
方法亮点：结合SXM和SECCM技术
关键发现：MXene薄片具有独特的电化学活性
insights_en: Novelty: Nanoscale chemical imaging reveals electrochemical reactions on MXene flakes
Method highlight: Combination of SXM and SECCM techniques
Key finding: MXene flakes exhibit unique electrochemical activity
abstract: Abstract Two-dimensional transition metal carbides and nitrides (MXenes) combine an electrochemically active surface with high conductivity and hydrophilicity, which makes them a unique class of materials for electrochemical applications. While the pseudocapacitive behaviour of MXenes in acidic environments is relatively well understood on macroscale electrodes, intrinsic electrochemical phenomena occurring on single MXene flakes remain unclear. Here, we use scanning X-ray microscopy (SXM) to correlate the electronic structure of Ti 3 C 2 T x MXene flakes at the nanoscale with local electrochemical reactions triggered at the sub-flake level by scanning electrochemical cell microscopy (SECCM). For several proton-coupled electron transfer reactions, including electrochemical oxidation and the hydrogen evolution reaction, we demonstrate a delocalization of the reactions well beyond the MXene flake area in contact with the droplet cell. Furthermore, we show evidence of hydrogen storage on monolayer MXene flakes. This work highlights fundamental insights into the role of interfacial water on surface redox reactions.

title: Nanometer-resolution imaging of living bacteria across species and cellular orientations
summary_zh: 本文通过改进的AFM技术，实现了对活细菌的纳米级成像。研究揭示了LPS复杂性与AFM对比度之间的关系。
summary_en: This paper achieves nanometer-resolution imaging of living bacteria using an improved AFM technique. The study reveals the relationship between LPS complexity and AFM contrast.
insights: 创新点：改进AFM技术实现活细菌纳米级成像
方法亮点：实现种间和细胞取向的稳健粘附
关键发现：LPS复杂性与AFM对比度相关
insights_en: Novelty: Improved AFM technique for nanometer-resolution imaging of living bacteria
Method highlight: Robust adhesion across species and cellular orientations
Key finding: LPS complexity is related to AFM contrast
abstract: Abstract The bacterial cell envelope is a complex superstructure that is an important target and a major barrier for antibiotics. To date, highest-resolution images of native cell envelopes have been obtained by atomic force microscopy (AFM), but its use is limited by challenges in bacterial immobilization. We establish glutaraldehyde-functionalized glass surfaces for reversible covalent attachment, enabling robust adhesion across species and cellular orientations while preserving cell viability and growth. This approach allowed imaging of Escherichia coli both expressing O-antigen and fully lacking lipopolysaccharide (LPS) oligosaccharides, revealing that AFM contrast depends on LPS complexity and confirming previously observed outer membrane domains as LPS-enriched islands. It also enabled imaging of Pseudomonas aeruginosa and Acinetobacter baumannii outer membranes, which lack the characteristic protein trimers observed in model E. coli . Finally, we discovered growth-phase dependent alterations in E. coli pole morphology, where trimer networks typical of exponential-phase cells were unresolved and morphological defects appeared.

title: Archival and palaeoenvironmental documentation of extreme climate events reveals generational amnesia in collective memory
summary_zh: 本文利用气候档案和树轮重建，发现集体记忆中存在代际遗忘现象。历史记录显示，对极端气候事件的严重性评估往往偏向于近期经验。
summary_en: This paper, using climatic archives and tree-ring reconstructions, finds a phenomenon of generational amnesia in collective memory. Historical records show that severity assessments of extreme climate events often bias toward recent experiences.
insights: 创新点：利用气候档案揭示集体记忆中的代际遗忘
方法亮点：结合气候档案和树轮重建
关键发现：历史记录显示评估偏向近期经验
insights_en: Novelty: Revealing generational amnesia in collective memory using climatic archives
Method highlight: Combination of climatic archives and tree-ring reconstructions
Key finding: Historical records show bias toward recent experiences in assessments
abstract: Abstract Collective memory shapes how societies respond to extreme climate events, yet long-term evidence on how the collective memory of such events becomes perceptually biased over time is lacking. Here, we utilise four centuries (1470–1900) of climatic archives from northern China, along with tree–ring–based hydroclimate reconstructions, which are validated against instrumental observations of Wet/Dry Index (1901–2000) to fill the gap. We find that historical records reveal systematic, non-random mismatches, where severity assessments are often biased toward recent experience rather than absolute climatic anomalies. Correlations between historical and natural records increase when the natural series is re-standardised using 20–40-year sliding windows, reflecting a generational offset. A heuristic agent-based model reproduces this pattern, suggesting that generational amnesia is sufficient to explain the offsets in perception of environmental change. We argue that historical archives carry a generational imprint of perceptual bias, in which the severity of climate extremes is judged against recent lived experience rather than long-term climate variability. This has implications for bias-aware corrections for risk assessment, adaptation, and paleoclimate reconstruction.

title: Repeated loss of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet’s Amundsen Sea sector during late Pleistocene interglacials
summary_zh: 本文通过研究南极大陆边缘沉积物，发现西南极冰盖在晚更新世间冰期经历了多次大规模融化。
summary_en: This paper, through the study of West Antarctic continental margin sediments, finds that the West Antarctic Ice Sheet experienced repeated major melting during the late Pleistocene interglacials.
insights: 创新点：研究南极大陆边缘沉积物揭示冰盖融化
方法亮点：分析粘土矿物组合和过去海洋温度
关键发现：冰盖融化导致海平面上升
insights_en: Novelty: Studying sedimentary records to reveal ice sheet melting
Method highlight: Analysis of clay mineral assemblages and past ocean temperatures
Key finding: Ice sheet melting led to sea level rise
abstract: Abstract Sea-level reconstructions and numerical models suggest that the vulnerable West Antarctic Ice Sheet underwent major mass losses during the late Pleistocene, raising global sea level by several metres. However, direct evidence from ice-sheet proximal records for such retreat has remained inconclusive. Here we investigate variations in clay mineral assemblages and past ocean temperatures archived in West Antarctic continental margin sediments during the last 800,000 years. Our results demonstrate that the supply of glacigenic detritus sourced from the main outlet glaciers in the Amundsen Sea sector of the West Antarctic Ice Sheet ceased almost entirely during all previous warm periods, documenting the loss of their drainage basins. Concomitant seawater warming, revealed by a microfossil proxy, is attributed to intensified deep-water advection towards Antarctica’s Pacific margin, which is corroborated by the clay mineralogical evidence. Our findings show that ocean forcing can drive major deglaciation of West Antarctica and related global sea-level rise.

title: Robust Reasoning Segmentation for Open-World MLLMs without Catastrophic Forgetting
summary_zh: 本文研究无灾难性遗忘的开放世界MLLM推理分割。方法上，引入LENS，一种轻量级插件式方法，在不损害基础完整性情况下赋予MLLM像素级能力。实验表明，LENS在不影响模型通用能力的情况下提高了分割性能。
summary_en: This paper studies robust reasoning segmentation for Open-World MLLMs without catastrophic forgetting. The method introduces LENS, a lightweight plug-and-play paradigm that equips MLLMs with pixel-level ability without compromising their foundational integrity. Experiments show that LENS improves segmentation performance without affecting the model's general-purpose capabilities.
insights: 创新点：LENS方法无灾难性遗忘
方法亮点：轻量级插件式方法
关键发现：提高分割性能而不损害通用能力
insights_en: Novelty: LENS method without catastrophic forgetting
Method highlight: Lightweight plug-and-play paradigm
Key finding: Improved segmentation performance without compromising general-purpose capabilities
abstract: Abstract Ensuring trustworthiness and versatility in Open-World Visual Recognition is a core goal of Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs). While integrating segmentation is desirable, prevailing methods require invasive fine-tuning, which often leads to catastrophic forgetting of the model’s general-purpose capabilities. This trade-off between task-specific performance and general reliability fundamentally undermines the goal of building unified, trustworthy systems. We introduce LENS ( L everaging k E ypoi N ts for MLLMs’ S egmentation), a novel plug-and-play paradigm designed to equip MLLMs with pixel-level ability without compromising their foundational integrity. LENS attaches a lightweight head to a completely frozen MLLM, interpreting the intrinsic spatial cues embedded in attention maps. It extracts keypoints and translates them into prompt-compatible features for a mask decoder. Extensive experiments validate that LENS achieves segmentation performance competitive with retraining-based methods. Crucially, it largely preserves the MLLM’s open-world generalization, avoiding the degradation observed in fine-tuned counterparts. By decoupling segmentation from generation, LENS offers a robust and efficient path toward truly multi-talented and reliable vision models.

summary_zh: 通过自突触灵感设计的神经形态硬件，实现局部双向反馈控制，应用于温度调节。
summary_en: An autapse-inspired neuromorphic hardware for localized bidirectional feedback control, applied in thermoregulation.
insights: 创新点：自突触灵感设计神经形态硬件
方法亮点：实现局部双向反馈控制
关键发现：应用于温度调节
insights_en: Novelty: Autapse-inspired neuromorphic hardware design
Method highlight: Achieving localized bidirectional feedback control
Key finding: Application in thermoregulation
abstract: Abstract Establishing autonomous and energy-efficient feedback control at the hardware level remains challenging because conventional systems rely on centralized processing and continuous external computation, increasing energy consumption and system complexity. Here we show a neuromorphic autapse-inspired system that enables localized and bidirectional feedback control, using thermoregulation as a representative application. An autapse is a self-synaptic connection in which a neuron feeds its output back to its own synaptic input, enabling intrinsic feedback modulation. The system integrates a solid electrolyte-based synaptic transistor capable of multiplexing multiple inputs and a bidirectional leaky integrate-and-fire artificial neuron. By feeding the neuronal output back to an additional synaptic gate, excitatory and inhibitory feedback loops are realized within a compact architecture. Using an artificial thermoregulation platform, temperature-dependent inputs bidirectionally modulate neuronal firing frequency, demonstrating biologically inspired feedback control with a compact set of neuromorphic devices for autonomous and energy-efficient systems.
